response.title: If my backup battery runs flat while I'm away, will the fridge come back on by itself when the power returns?
response.answer:
Yes. In most cases, your refrigerator will automatically turn back on when power returns, even if your backup battery completely runs flat while you're away.

Here's what typically happens:

Power outage: Your backup battery starts powering the fridge.

Battery runs flat: The battery's inverter shuts off, and the fridge loses power.

Grid power returns: The backup system restores AC power to the fridge (assuming it supports automatic pass-through or transfer).

Fridge restarts: Most refrigerators automatically resume cooling using their previous temperature settings.

A few things to watch out for

Backup battery: Some portable power stations require you to manually reactivate their AC output after a complete shutdown.

Refrigerator: Most standard refrigerators restart automatically, but certain smart models may behave differently.

Compressor delay: The fridge may wait several minutes before restarting its compressor. This is normal.

One important question

What brand and model is your backup battery? (For example, EcoFlow DELTA 2, Anker SOLIX F2000, or Bluetti AC200L.)

The battery model is actually more important than the fridge model here. I can help you determine whether it will automatically restore AC output after the battery drains completely and grid power comes back.
